NAME: ALERT_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: SO23 shared lists when ALERT_<route> is blank (comma list)

NAME: ALERT_ESCALATION_WINDOW_H
DESCRIPTION: Escalation look-back window of an alert rule (hours)

NAME: ALERT_EXC_APP_LINK
DESCRIPTION: Exceptions app link in the alert e-mail (blank = app name)

NAME: ALERT_MAIL_RENDERER
DESCRIPTION: Alert e-mail renderer: SMTG (built-in fallback) or BUILTIN

NAME: ALERT_SECTION_CLASS
DESCRIPTION: Consumer section of the alert message (blank = none)

NAME: ALERT_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Generic alert e-mail template (rule and channel name none)

NAME: ALERT_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of the times in the alert e-mail (TTZZ)

NAME: CHECK_STALE_MIN_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Area dashboard: a run older than this is stale (minutes)

NAME: CONTROL_TEAMS
DESCRIPTION: Teams a control may name (control register; comma list)

NAME: CONTROL_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of business date and review cut-off (TTZZ)

NAME: DOWNTIME_MAX_HOURS
DESCRIPTION: Longest planned downtime window (hours)

NAME: DOWNTIME_PAST_TOL_MIN
DESCRIPTION: Minutes a downtime window may start in the past on save

NAME: DOWNTIME_RETENTION_DAYS
DESCRIPTION: Retention of ended downtime windows (days; >= 30)

NAME: DOWNTIME_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone in which downtime windows are entered (TTZZ)

NAME: ESC_MAX_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Escalations of one exception when the rule names none

NAME: EXC_REASON_CODES
DESCRIPTION: Reason codes of an open exception (classification)

NAME: METRIC_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of month / week of the response-time metrics

NAME: PURGE_PACKAGE_SIZE
DESCRIPTION: Rows deleted per purge package

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_ALERT_LOG
DESCRIPTION: Retention of alert log rows (days; at least 30 applied)

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_REVIEW
DESCRIPTION: Retention of daily control sign-offs (days; >= 30)

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_RUN
DESCRIPTION: Retention of runs and findings (days; >= 30)

NAME: SHIFT_TIMES_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Shift start times (HHMMSS rows) of teams without own times

NAME: SHIFT_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of the shift start times (TTZZ)

NAME: SLA_DAYS_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: SLA days of an exception when SLA_DAYS_<area>_<sev> blank
